## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] One change in this PR, linked to an issue
- [ ] Before/after screenshot attached (new or changed effects, UI changes). Use a public or synthetic image, nothing private.
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`) if behavior, shortcuts, privacy or the proxy changed
- [ ] No new network requests from the page, no analytics, no image data leaving the browser
